react.description: Buttons prompt most actions in a UI

tags.devx:
- Requires exactly one visible-content source: `label` or children.
- Custom non-text children require an explicit accessible name such as `aria-label`.
- `pressed` is controlled; `defaultPressed` initializes uncontrolled usage.
- `toggleable` enables `aria-pressed` and `onPressedChange` on action buttons.
- `type` defaults to `'button'` to prevent accidental form submits.
tags.a11y:
- Uses native button/link semantics and preserves its accessible name while loading.
- Provides a 48px touch target and a visible `:focus-visible` outline.
tags.limitations:
- When `href` is set with `disabled`, the link is made inert via `aria-disabled` and `tabIndex={-1}`.
- Navigation links ignore toggle state; use `aria-current` for the current destination.

transition.name: transition
transition.description: Motion transition shared by every framework for shape changes.

icon.name: icon
icon.description: An optional icon to display in the button (agnostic Icon data).

type.name: type
type.description: The HTML button type attribute. Only applies when rendered as `<button>`.

iconPosition.name: iconPosition
iconPosition.description:
Logical icon position. The `left` and `right` aliases are retained for
compatibility and resolve to `start` and `end` respectively.

size.name: size
size.description: Visual size; every option retains a 48px touch target.

variant.name: variant
variant.description:
The button variant determines the style of the button.
Aliases: 'primary' maps to 'filled', 'secondary' maps to 'tonal'

disabled.name: disabled
disabled.description: Disables the button if set to true.

edgeAligned.name: edgeAligned
edgeAligned.description:
Aligns text-button content with the surrounding inline edge.
Only applies to `text` variant buttons.

loading.name: loading
loading.description: Blocks interaction and exposes the busy state while preserving the label.

shape.name: shape
shape.description: The shape of the button defines whether it is squared or rounded.

shapeFeedback.name: shapeFeedback
shapeFeedback.description: Shape feedback shown for accepted press and toggle interactions.

toggleable.name: toggleable
toggleable.description: Enables the semantic pressed state and its visual treatment.

pressed.name: pressed
pressed.description:
Controlled pressed state. Framework adapters expose the matching change
event (`onPressedChange` in React, `pressedChange` in Angular).

defaultPressed.name: defaultPressed
defaultPressed.description: Initial pressed state when `pressed` is not controlled.

label.name: label
label.description: Visible text content. Do not combine with `children`.

children.name: children
children.description: Custom visible content. Use `aria-label` when it has no accessible text.

className.name: className
className.description: Classes or state-aware element classes applied through the shared style contract.

href.name: href
href.description: Navigation destination; switches the native element from button to link.

ref.name: ref
ref.description:
Ref forwarded to the native button element.
Ref forwarded to the native anchor element.

onClick.name: onClick
onClick.description:
Handles clicks accepted by the button interaction contract.
Handles clicks accepted by the link interaction contract.

angular.description: Buttons prompt most actions in a UI.

- Projected non-text content requires an explicit `aria-label`.
- `pressed` is controlled; `defaultPressed` initializes uncontrolled usage.

tags.limitations:
